bibl.title: Bulletin of Online Emendations to Papyri (BOEP) 10 (November 2, 2022)
bibl.seg: Rodney Ast, Lajos Berkes, James M.S. Cowey, Holger Essler & Julia Lougovaya, Bulletin of Online Emendations to Papyri (BOEP) 10 (November 2, 2022).
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 2 (2022) §1-5, fig.
bibl.note: This installment reports all of the emendation proposals to Greek, Latin and Coptic documentary and literary texts that were accepted to either the Duke Databank of Documentary Papyri or the Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri via the Papyrological Editor (PE) between April 24, 2021 and November 2, 2022. The new readings [by M.J. Albarrán, R. Ast, T. Backhuys, R.S. Bagnall, C. Balamoshev, A. Benaissa, L. Berkes, A. Boud'hors, Y. Broux, W.G. Claytor, F. Corazza, J.M.S. Cowey, L. De Curtis, A. de Frutos García, M.G. Elmaghrabi, H. Essler, J.-L. Fournet, L. Gericke, N. Gonis, D. Hagedorn, P. Heilporn, W.B. Henry, L. Jiménez, D. Kaltsas, S. Kovarik, B. Laudenbach, N. Litinas, J. Lougovaya, A. Monte, G. Papaioannou, N. Reggiani, F. Reiter, M. Resel, C.M. Sampson, A. Skalec, A. Sonina, A. Stornaiuolo, C. Theilemann, L. Vanderheyden & U. Yiftach] have been vetted by members of the PE's editorial board.
